statements.__comment__: DEPRECATED: temporary backward-compatibility migration; remove in v1.0.0. CVEMetadata enriched every CVE-backed SemgrepSCAFinding while it carried :CVE. The next statement removes that label, after which CVEMetadata cleanup, which matches :CVE targets, can no longer reach these edges, so delete them first. Scoped to the findings of the deployment that just completed its sync, whose CVE-backed findings all link to their SemgrepSCAVulnerability. Idempotent: findings no longer get ENRICHES edges. Each run deletes up to $SCAN_LIMIT_SIZE edges from one scan of the deployment, committing every $LIMIT_SIZE.
statements.query: MATCH (:SemgrepDeployment {id: $DEPLOYMENT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(f:SemgrepSCAFinding:CVE)<-[r:ENRICHES]-(:CVEMetadata) WITH r LIMIT $SCAN_LIMIT_SIZE CALL (r) { DELETE r } IN TRANSACTIONS OF $LIMIT_SIZE ROWS

statements.__comment__: DEPRECATED: temporary backward-compatibility migration; remove in v1.0.0. Earlier releases put the :CVE ontology label on every CVE-backed SemgrepSCAFinding, and wrote the CVE _ont_* fields on every SemgrepSCAFinding, advisory-only ones included. The CVE is now the SemgrepSCAVulnerability the finding links to, and nothing updates these any more, so strip them: left stale, :CVE queries count each Semgrep CVE once per affected repository. _ont_source and the SecurityIssue _ont_* fields stay, since the SecurityIssue mapping still writes them. Idempotent: once stripped, no SemgrepSCAFinding matches. Batched like the statement above.
statements.query: MATCH (:SemgrepDeployment {id: $DEPLOYMENT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(f:SemgrepSCAFinding) WHERE f:CVE OR f._ont_cve_id IS NOT NULL OR f._ont_description IS NOT NULL OR f._ont_references IS NOT NULL OR f._ont_base_severity IS NOT NULL WITH f LIMIT $SCAN_LIMIT_SIZE CALL (f) { REMOVE f:CVE, f._ont_cve_id, f._ont_description, f._ont_references, f._ont_base_severity } IN TRANSACTIONS OF $LIMIT_SIZE ROWS

name: Semgrep SCA - migrate CVE labels written by earlier versions
